## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes (coverage stays at/above 95%)
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] `mypy` passes
- [ ] If this adds/changes a loader: tests use mocked content copied from a
      real `curl` of the raw file, not invented data
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`'s `[Unreleased]` section is updated
- [ ] README updated if the public API changed
